signal_description: Historic MLB debut: three home runs in first three at-bats, becoming the first player in MLB history to homer three times in his debut.
headline: Historic debut creates an immediate attention shock
why_now: The performance is already an acceleration event, so the opportunity question is whether card prices have lagged the attention spike enough to leave a narrow entry window.

falsification: Post-debut sold comps show the target cards have already repriced beyond the acceptable chase threshold.
